_meta.note: docs/GROUP_RELAY.md 'Limits' section: sixty waypoints and thirty pings per group; past that the oldest goes. A burst of 61 posts evicts the squad's oldest real waypoint rather than being refused.

scenario.observedEffect: After 61 rapid posts, the cap of 60 evicts the 5 pre-existing legitimate waypoints (oldest-first) along with 55 of the spam ones, leaving only the 6 most recent spam entries — the squad's actual plan is gone.
